oracle_semantics.replaces_legacy: desktop_clean (which naively conflated desktop isolation with emptiness)

desktop_environment_audit.audit_explanation: The agent process executes in window station 'WinSta0' on thread desktop 'exebox-2XQJQ2XOKLBINR3SI4V7POKAIV'. In Windows Win32 API, EnumWindows enumerates top-level windows belonging strictly to the desktop associated with the calling thread. In an isolated execution desktop (exebox-2XQJQ2XOKLBINR3SI4V7POKAIV), there are zero pre-existing shell/explorer windows; only windows created by processes running on that desktop exist. Once test-launched windows close, the window count on this desktop returns to 0. A naive 'desktop_clean' metric conflated this isolation with world emptiness. The oracle must judge restoration relative to task and harness ownership, not global desktop vacancy.
